folds.heading: ## Full content reconciliation and local variants, 2026-11-04 (B70)
folds.body:
The full original sweep, appended group returns and rounds 2–4/addendum were read, preserving WG1–WG26, WGP1–WGP4, WGX1–WGX6, source-local runner-ups and G4-X1–X6. Use the existing [pack-detail correction](world_pack_details_2026-10-20/REPORT.md#continuous-content-reconciliation-2026-11-04-b66) and current local owners before acting on older no-native/no-source or pending-play summaries. An unrelated build change does not invalidate unchanged relevant evidence; this is not a new C-level census. C4 concerns a frozen represented scope; C5’s director feedback is optional under AD42. Group keyword searches and explicitly unread source bodies remain limited, not proof of absence or fresh canon authentication. The round-4 addendum supplies the later bounded MoL/HP/Shadow Slave/COI pass, correcting the preceding not-yet-pass sentence without claiming full-source coverage.

WG proposals do not impose universal complications: calibration needs an actual differing mechanism, a poor reading needs supported source/method limits, and aftermath requires an actor/cause rather than a balancing tax. Broad perception, ambient power, contract and monetary assertions marked for source confirmation stay at that evidence level; faculty, technique, body, era and alternate means can differ. A narrower selected noncombat loop need not acquire full physiology, sea logistics, two daily jobs, a public-profile combat reader or a society simulator. Frozen absence does not itself prove a missing season; declared present-time/instance/service clocks decide actual expiry. Current food/comfort direction is not overridden by an old hunger or overnight done-check example (AD5/AD38).

WGX/G4-X rows are compatible variants, not six required systems per world. A split/merge follows actual material and certification semantics, rather than universal weakest-quality chemistry. Sold goods may be consumed, transformed or sold without guaranteed buyback or named purchaser. Reservations protect the allocated claim, not necessarily all shared stock. Merchant float needs an actual replenishment source; no daily coin creation follows. Ordinary work may improve familiarity without compulsory new strain, and a favor retains its actual creditor/unit/terms without mandatory money conversion. These options, measured evidence limits and useful history remain preserved under AD32/AD36; no new authority, world selection, source acquisition or runtime implementation is implied.
